get.description: resetTime and predictedResetTime are UTC ISO timestamps or null. hasAnnouncement distinguishes an active announcement from no announcement; announcedResetTime is a BusinessTime object, or null when the announcement has no published schedule. Unknown schedules do not use the statistical prediction or trigger inferred confirmation. Inferred confirmations use an explicit announcement expiry boundary as an instant. Expired predictions retain their original timestamp.

get.summary: codex events with accepted actions and all source links
get.description: Activity history includes announcements, confirmations, progress and amendments, with their available source links. Each event has its own current overview. Known business times are structured objects: instant {at}, date {date,timeZone}, range {from,through}, or deadline {at}. An announcement and its announced event may have time=null when no schedule is published; unknown times use publishedAt only for sorting and date filtering. Instant timestamps use UTC and date precision is preserved. Publication timestamps remain ISO strings. Dates are never padded with an assumed clock time. Individual quota status remains subject to the account display.

parameters.description: IANA time zone; the site uses Asia/Shanghai.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Omit to return all events in range.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to platform, dates, time zone and limit.
